fields.title: VNEPS tender/plan/award record
fields.description: One record per VNEPS ('contractor selection') search hit, produced by mode=list, or one full award/contract detail record produced by mode=detail (fetched by inputResultId). List records blend several record types (procurement plans, tender notices, award results, and signed contracts) -- fields not applicable to a given record's type are simply null. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a record can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: the search parameters that produced this page. For detail records: the inputResultId that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-smart-search, S1-contractor-input-result-detail, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

titleDisplay.title: Title
titleDisplay.description: (list only) The bid/plan name, pulled up from the upstream array field for readability.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: (list only) Upstream 'type': es-plan-project-p (procurement plan), es-notify-contractor (tender notice / award result), etc.

stepCode.title: Step code
stepCode.description: (list only) The record's lifecycle stage, e.g. plan-step-1, notify-contractor-step-4-kqlcnt (award-result stage).

notifyNo.title: Notify number
notifyNo.description: The tender notice's own reference number, when applicable.

planNo.title: Plan number
planNo.description: The procurement plan's own reference number, when applicable.

procuringEntityName.title: Procuring entity name
procuringEntityName.description: The government/state body running this procurement.

investorName.title: Investor name
investorName.description: The investor/owner named on the record (often the same as procuringEntityName).

provinceNames.title: Province names
provinceNames.description: (list only) Vietnamese province/city name(s) associated with the record's location.

publicDate.title: Public date
publicDate.description: When this record was published on VNEPS (local Vietnam time, no timezone suffix).

decisionDate.title: Decision date
decisionDate.description: Date of the underlying approval/decision document.

investField.title: Investment field
investField.description: Upstream category code(s), e.g. TV (consulting), HH (goods), XL (construction).

investTotal.title: Investment total
investTotal.description: (list only) Total estimated investment value, in VND, when applicable.

bidPriceDisplay.title: Bid price
bidPriceDisplay.description: (list only) Estimated bid/package price, in VND.

winningContractorDisplay.title: Winning contractor
winningContractorDisplay.description: (list only) Winning contractor's legal name, when the record has reached the award stage.

bidWinningPriceDisplay.title: Winning price
bidWinningPriceDisplay.description: (list only) Winning bid price, in VND, when the record has reached the award stage.

inputResultId.title: Input result ID
inputResultId.description: Present when this record has a contractor-selection-result stage -- pass this into a 'detail' mode run for the full award/contract detail (winner org/tax code, decision documents, lot-by-lot results).

raw.title: Raw search hit
raw.description: (list only) The complete upstream search-hit object verbatim -- field set varies by recordType; passed through as-is rather than enumerated field-by-field.

bidNo.title: Bid number
bidNo.description: (detail only) The package's own bid reference number.

decisionNo.title: Decision number
decisionNo.description: (detail only) The award decision document's reference number.

decisionAgency.title: Decision agency
decisionAgency.description: (detail only) The body that issued the award decision.

lotCount.title: Lot count
lotCount.description: (detail only) Number of lots on this award result.

winningContractorOrgCodes.title: Winning contractor org codes
winningContractorOrgCodes.description: (detail only) System org code(s) of the winning contractor(s) -- this endpoint does not carry the plain legal name; see a matching 'list' record's winningContractorDisplay for that.

winningContractorTaxCodes.title: Winning contractor tax codes
winningContractorTaxCodes.description: (detail only) Vietnamese tax code(s) of the winning contractor(s).

winningPrices.title: Winning prices
winningPrices.description: (detail only) Winning bid price(s) per lot, in VND.

fullDetail.title: Full detail (raw)
fullDetail.description: (detail only) The complete upstream detail response verbatim -- decision documents, per-lot contractor results, contact emails, contract periods, and more.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
